item.description: Some animal species have their eyes positioned on their heads differently than how people do – and it comes with pluses and minuses for how they see.

item.title: Medieval City Walls Discovered Beneath Florence
item.description: Archaeologists in Florence have uncovered medieval city walls, a 14th-century bridge and gateway structures that may have a connection to Giotto.

item.title: AI may have solved one of math’s biggest puzzles, raising controversy
item.description: For decades, researchers wondered if the Navier-Stokes equations, which describe fluid flow, break down. OpenAI put thousands of agents on the question.

item.title: The shingles vaccine may protect the heart
item.description: Shingrix, the same vaccine that protects people from the blistering shingles rash, might also lower risk of heart disease.

item.title: Was the ‘American cheetah’ a cheetah at all?
item.description: Ancient DNA confirms Miracinonyx trumani was more closely related to modern pumas than cheetahs and had a more varied diet than previously thought.
